summary: Frontend + integration testing of LUMIÈRE Agentic Experience Studio completed successfully with seeded session token e2e_1788105676 and pre-seeded experience f3f5a6a6-6f9c-4ee9-8b8e-21dd6ae1975d. All auth gating, dashboard, workspace tabs (Story/Capture/Evaluate/Edit/Trace), language toggle, and new-experience dialog work as specified. Backend integration (media URLs signed with lumiere_token, agent runs, rendered cuts) is properly wired.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to each Radix DialogContent (e.g. New Experience dialog) to remove console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Adapters (AgentBuilderAdapter direct_gemini + PartnerAdapter mock) are correctly surfaced as NOT CONNECTED / MOCK in the Trace tab — intentional and matches the review request.
Media file URLs correctly include ?auth=<lumiere_token> from localStorage — signed access works and the video src verifies token is injected.
Radix Dialog a11y: DialogContent instances are missing an accessible description (console warning). Low priority.
test_credentials: Session token e2e_1788105676 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). GET /api/auth/me returned 200 for user_e2e_1788105676. Cookie name session_token + localStorage lumiere_token both set before navigation, per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded experience f3f5a6a6-6f9c-4ee9-8b8e-21dd6ae1975d and pre-seeded session e2e_1788105676.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth pattern that works for Playwright: (1) context.add_cookies with session_token cookie for the preview host (secure=True, sameSite=None, httpOnly=True), AND (2) context.add_init_script to set localStorage.lumiere_token BEFORE any goto. After that /studio and /studio/:id load without any redirect. The seeded experience contains full agent trace (7 runs), 9 GTS cards, and 2 rendered cut versions (V1 + V2) — good for pure UI regression without needing to run Gemini (~45s planning) again. The optional new-experience creation flow was not exercised end-to-end (Gemini planning long-running) but the dialog fields render correctly.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All described features render and integrate correctly.
